correctness.rationale: The star and top simplices meet pairwise in at most an edge, so the apex collapse eliminates all faces above dimension two without affecting the graph. The triangular two-skeleton of the convex hypersimplex supplies simple connectivity. In reduced Euler character, each edge contributes to two local simplex sums and once globally, leaving one signed edge module; flags and augmentation have the displayed signs. This yields the stated characteristic, and Jacobi–Trudi telescoping cancels the boundary terms using e2=h1^2-h2. The partitions are legitimate and distinct for n>=2k; absence of the trivial and sign representations proves the two invariant-vanishing claims. Independent clique enumeration and hook lengths gave face counts 70,560,1120,560,112 and dimensions 35,90,56 summing to 181 (python3 /workspace/check_frozen_math.py). Frozen verification files were inspected, not executed. Here 'self-complementary' should mean the middle layer admits the set-complement automorphism, not that J(8,4) is isomorphic to its graph complement.
